newsitem.title: CANADA: Bema Gold closes C$88 mln share issue.
newsitem.headline: Bema Gold closes C$88 mln share issue.

text.p: Bema Gold Corp said on Tuesday it has closed an C$88 million equity financing.

First Marathon Securities Ltd, Yorkton Securities Inc and Nesbitt Burns Inc underwrote seven million shares and exercised their option to increase the offering by one million shares, for a total of eight million shares at C$11 each, the company said in a statement.
Bema said it intends to use C$10 million to fund its portion of an expanded deep drilling program at the Cerro Casale deposit on the Aldebaran property in Chile.
The next drill results from the property are expected in about four weeks, the company said.
The company said it would invest C$14 million into shares of its partner at Aldebaran, Arizona Star Resource Corp.
Bema said it will also start an initial 2,500 metre reverse circulation drill program in October on its Quebrada property in Chile.
